description: Work out a tip and split a bill between people, in whole cents. round "none" rounds the tip to the cent; "up-total" rounds the total up to the next whole unit; "up-each" rounds each person's share up to the next whole unit and the total becomes shares times people. Returns tip, total and per_person as decimal strings. Free. Make receipts only for lawful purposes, such as replacing a lost receipt, bookkeeping, testing or design mockups. Using a receipt to deceive anyone, including for refunds, expense claims or proof of purchase, is prohibited.

bill.description: The bill before the tip, as a decimal string like 87.40

people.description: How many people share the bill

round.description: none: to the cent. up-total: round the total up. up-each: round each share up

name: calculate_tip
